sentences.text: Just as the hour of 05:30 arrived, the house sensed a peculiar stir, announcing that "the machines waking up".
A ghostly current suddenly surged, recording an observed appliance energy of 360 Wh.
This supernatural energy was significantly higher than the expected 50 Wh, soaring beyond the anticipated range of 39 Wh to 76 Wh.
The spectral activity continued until 06:00, leaving the slumbering house buzzing with an unusual charge.
